जठर १

JAṬHARA I . A very erudite brahmin scholar in Vedic lore. jaṭhara was a prominent figure at the serpent yajña held by janamejaya. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 53, Verse 8).

जठर २

JAṬHARA II . A mountain within the ranges of mahāmeru. On the eastern side of mahāmeru there exist two mountains called jaṭhara and devakūṭa, 18,000 yojanas in extent and 2000 yojanas high. On the western side of Meru are the mountains called pavamāna and pāriyātra, on the southern side kailāsa and karavīra, and on the northern side triśṛṅga and makaragiri. (devī bhāgavata, 8th skandha).

जठर ३

JAṬHARA III . An urban region in ancient india.

जाठर

JĀṬHARA . A warrior of subrahmaṇya. (M.B. śalya Parva, Chapter 46, Stanza 128).
